parsed.elsewhere_quote:
It follows from (9) that
\[
d\le \left|\sum_{i\in P}r_i-\sum_{i\in Q}r_i\right|
\le\sum_{i=0}^n r_i=D. \tag{10}
\]
Thus Liu Bang's construction guarantees $D\ge d$.
parsed.explanation: The exchange explicitly shows that some minimum-cost pairing contains $(x_1,x_2)$; deleting that pair gives the identical problem on the remaining $2r-2$ lengths, so the stated induction is complete at normal olympiad-proof granularity. Appending $0$ bijectively converts an odd pairing-plus-singleton into an even pairing with the same cost. Hence the pairing lemma, and its use in the all-$n$ lower bound, are established as written.
